cards.name: HDFC Infinia
cards.notes: Base = 5 RP/₹150, valuing 1 RP = ₹1 (best-case redemption via SmartBuy flights/hotels; cash/statement credit is worth far less, ~₹0.30/RP). SmartBuy rewards were cut in Jan 2026 and again in Jul 2026 — reconfirm all SmartBuy multipliers/caps before relying on them.

smartbuy_vouchers.notes: 5X on GyFTR/Woohoo brand vouchers (Amazon/Flipkart/Swiggy/Zomato etc.), 25 RP/₹150. As of Jul 2026 this category is capped at 3,000 bonus points/month (~₹18,000 of voucher spend at this rate).

smartbuy_hotels.notes: 10X on hotel bookings via SmartBuy, 50 RP/₹150. No dedicated sub-cap reported as of Sep 2026, but subject to any overall SmartBuy ceiling — verify current terms.

smartbuy_flights.notes: 5X on flight bookings via SmartBuy, 25 RP/₹150.

international_spend.notes: Base 3.33% minus a 2% forex markup = 1.33% net. Enrolling in HDFC's Global Value Program adds 1% cashback on int'l spend, capped at ₹1,000/statement cycle — worth ~2.33% net if enrolled and under the cap. A separate 1.75% Dynamic Currency Conversion fee applies if you accept billing in INR abroad — always pay in local currency.

cards.name: HSBC Premier Metal
cards.notes: Base = 3 RP/₹100, valuing 1 RP ≈ ₹1 (transfer to airline/hotel partners at ~1:1). No rewards on fuel; utility + insurance spend earns rewards only up to ₹1L/month combined — don't route fuel to this card.

marketplace_travel.notes: Up to 12X reported on HSBC Marketplace flight/hotel/car-rental bookings — this is rich enough that it may be tiered or promotional. Confirm the current live multiplier before counting on it.

apple_unicorn.notes: 6X on Apple purchases via the HSBC Unicorn portal.

international_spend.notes: Base 3% minus a 0.99% standard forex markup = 2.01% net (HSBC's forex markup is among the lowest in the market — industry norm is ~3.5%). HSBC is running a 0% forex markup promo from 15 Aug-15 Sep 2026; during a 0% window this channel is really worth the full 3% base — check if the promo is still live before relying on 2.01%.

cards.name: Axis Magnus for Burgundy
cards.notes: Base = 12 EDGE pts/₹200 up to ₹1.5L/month, valuing 1 EDGE point ≈ ₹1 (best-case airline/hotel transfer at 5:4 for legacy partners, 5:2 for newer ones like BA/Finnair — so real value is often lower). Incremental spend beyond ₹1.5L/month in a calendar month jumps to 35 pts/₹200 (17.5%) — not modeled as a separate channel here since it only applies once you clear that threshold. Annual fee ₹30,000+GST, relationship-invite only.

travel_edge_portal.notes: 60 EDGE pts/₹200 via the Travel EDGE portal, capped at ₹2L of monthly spend at this rate.

international_spend.notes: Base 6% minus a 2%+GST (~2.36%) forex markup = 3.64% net. Lower than Axis Olympus's international_spend channel (5.8% net) — route foreign spend to Olympus instead unless you need Magnus for a specific reason.

cards.name: Axis Olympus
cards.notes: 1 EDGE Mile/₹100 domestic, each mile transfers at 1:4 to airline/hotel partners (Air India, KrisFlyer, Aeroplan, Flying Blue, IHG, etc.), up to 7.5L EDGE Miles/year. Annual fee ₹20,000; welcome benefit ₹10,000 Taj/ITC voucher + 2,500 EDGE Miles.

international_spend.notes: 2 EDGE Miles/₹100 (8% gross via 1:4 transfer) on international spend, net ~5.8% after the 1.8%+GST forex markup.

cards.name: IndusInd Legend
cards.notes: Weekday rate = 1 RP/₹100, valuing 1 RP = ₹0.75 cash redemption. This optimizer has no day-of-week logic — route weekend-heavy categories to the weekend_spend channel below manually. No rewards multiplier on medical/auto/telecom (flat 1 RP/₹100 both weekday and weekend, same as base). Charges a 1.8% forex markup on international spend, which exceeds this card's own reward rate — never route international spend here. Card name assumed from 'mental heritage' — confirm this is the IndusInd Legend metal card and correct if not.

weekend_spend.notes: 2 RP/₹100 on Saturday-Sunday spend vs. 1 RP/₹100 on weekdays. Only route spend here that you know will actually happen on a weekend.

low_yield_categories.notes: 0.70 RP/₹100 on utilities, insurance, government services, education fees, and rent — worse than base; only relevant if this is your only card in that category.

milestones.name: Year-1 spend bonus
milestones.period: one-time, within 1 year of card issuance
